options.fare_basis: Full-price single Paris Region <> Airports ticket per person; fare effective 2026-01-01. Any cost of purchasing a physical ticket holder is not included.
options.duration_basis: Approximate station-to-station journey; excludes baggage collection, terminal walking, waiting and onward travel to a hotel.
options.operating_hours: General published metro operating window: approximately 05:30 to 01:55, depending on the day. This is not a verified first/last departure from Orly station.
notes: Reference information, not live departures or disruption status. Check the operator's journey planner for the travel date.
The airport ticket includes eligible metro/RER/train connections within two hours without leaving the network; it excludes bus and tram journeys.
The airport-access overview contains an older EUR 13 fare; use the separate 2026 fare page for pricing.
A single documented option does not establish the cheapest or fastest airport transport option.
